integrity: The complete derivation and a standalone exact rational checker are provided. Verification tests finite systems; the asymptotic proof is analytic. Historical-priority risks from broader nonlinear voting and inaccessible indexed full text are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-state probabilities are for an asynchronous pure-conformity endpoint, not the synchronous, interior-weight payoff-and-conformity game of Manfredi et al. No empirical interpretation, general-network theorem or independent originality certification is asserted.
title: Exact fixation and quadratic leaf-seed suppression under asynchronous closed-neighborhood conformity
